subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Should #87711 remain the canonical tracker for the broad Telegram reset/session wedge family, or should maintainers split it into a narrow core durability bug plus Telegram UX follow-ups?
rationale: A concrete core write-ordering bug remains, but the issue also asks for heartbeat UX, delivery placeholders, metadata schema, warm-reset docs, and recovery semantics that need maintainer scoping before automation can safely implement them as one change.

options.title: Split into narrow work items
options.body: Keep this issue open as the root context, create or designate a focused core reset durability bug, and track Telegram UX/diagnostics separately.

options.title: Keep as canonical tracker
options.body: Use this issue as the single umbrella for the whole reset/session wedge family and require maintainer-owned sequencing before fixes land.

options.title: Defer the UX portions
options.body: Prioritize only the core session binding invariant now and leave heartbeat/docs/schema improvements for later explicit requests.

recommendation.title: Split into narrow work items
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the root context, create or designate a focused core reset durability bug, and track Telegram UX/diagnostics separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Their focused reset transcript/session history is the strongest available routing signal for the remaining core lifecycle decision.
